picks.title: Northern Michigan artist leaves his mark on communities, one mural at a time
picks.desc: TRAVERSE CITY - A new mural at the Traverse City Civic Center is giving people another way to connect with Northern Michigan’s history through the work of artist Nik Burkhart. Burkhart created the storytelling artwork to explore the area’s history through visual elements. The mural is part of a growing collection of public art projects he has completed since returning to Northern Michigan in 2021, after spending 12 years pursuing an art career in Chicago. Burkhart’s artistic roots in Northern Michigan go back to his college years. At 19, he received an early opportunity to bring his work into the public sphere with a mural at the Emmet County Fairgrounds.
